title: Wi-Tek WI-AC108P V2 High-performance 2.5Gbps Cloud PoE Gateway Controller 64 AP Cloud Controller

items.h: Supports up to 64 Access Points management

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Wi-Tek WI-AC108P (V2) is a high-performance cloud PoE gateway controller designed to centrally manage wireless networks with efficiency and reliability. With a powerful 2.5Gbps throughput, this controller can manage up to 64 access points, making it ideal for enterprise, campus, hotel, and office networking environments.


Equipped with PoE support and cloud management, the device allows administrators to monitor, configure, and manage the entire wireless infrastructure remotely. It simplifies network deployment while ensuring stable connectivity, advanced security, and seamless roaming across multiple access points.


Key Features


  • Supports up to 64 Access Points management
  • 2.5Gbps high-performance throughput
  • Built-in Cloud Management Controller
  • PoE support for easy network deployment
  • Centralized wireless network management
  • Supports seamless roaming across APs
  • Advanced security and VLAN support
  • Ideal for enterprise and large-scale wireless networks
